models.description: Trivial requests: short factual questions, renaming, one-line edits, running a single known command, formatting.
Routine coding: small features, fixing a clear bug, writing tests for existing code, explaining a file.
Hard engineering: multi-file changes, unclear bugs, architecture and design decisions, careful review.
The hardest long-horizon work: large refactors across a codebase, deep research, problems other models failed on.
